title: Orqenix Release Trigger Payload
description: Payload sent via repository_dispatch from OSS workflow to Pro workflow

oss_version.description: OSS semver version that Pro should depend on

trigger_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID of the triggering workflow

triggered_by.description: GitHub user who triggered the release

dry_run.description: Whether Pro should publish or just validate
